data.body: Build UI to search/filter devices by dev_eui or failure type. Display status, last activity, active failures. Add e2e tests for search/filter.

✓ Review Complete

Implementation verified against specification:

**Code Structure:**
- telemetry/templates/devices_search.html (200 lines) — Search/list template
- telemetry/templates/device_detail.html (140 lines) — Device detail template
- telemetry/static/js/devices-search.js (450 lines) — Client-side logic
- telemetry/static/css/devices.css (550 lines) — Responsive styling
- telemetry/views.py (2 new views) — TemplateView classes
- telemetry/urls.py (2 new routes) — URL patterns for both pages
- e2e/test_devices_ui.py (350 lines) — Comprehensive E2E tests

**Features Implemented:**
✓ Search box with debounced API calls (?search=device1)
✓ Status filter (All/Passing/Failing) with radio buttons
✓ Failure type filter (Inactivity/Out of Range/Frequency) with checkboxes
✓ Server-side sorting by dev_eui, latest_status, updated_at
✓ Pagination with prev/next controls, page info
✓ Device list table with status indicators, failure counts, relative times
✓ Device detail view with overview, active failures, health config
✓ Failure cards with type badges and specific details
✓ Copy-to-clipboard for device IDs
✓ URL query params reflect current filters (shareable URLs)
✓ Loading states and error handling with retry buttons
✓ Responsive design (mobile 375px, tablet 768px, desktop 1920px)
✓ Light/dark mode support with CSS variables
✓ Accessible HTML, semantic markup, WCAG AA colors
✓ Relative time formatting ("5 min ago", "2 hours ago")

**API Integration:**
✓ Uses HDT-17 enhancements (SearchFilter, status filter, ordering)
✓ All search/filter/sort executed server-side
✓ Proper debouncing (300ms) on search/filter changes
✓ No N+1 queries (uses prefetch_related for failures)

**E2E Tests (30+ test cases):**
✓ Page load, element visibility
✓ Search functionality with substring matching
✓ Filter by status and failure types
✓ Pagination navigation
✓ Sorting by device ID, status, last activity
✓ Clear search and filters
✓ Navigation to device detail
✓ Device not found error handling
✓ Empty state messaging
✓ Mobile/tablet/desktop viewports

**Code Quality:**
✓ No XSS vulnerabilities (escapeHtml utility)
✓ Graceful error handling and network timeouts
✓ Clean separation: views handle routing, JS handles interactivity
✓ Consistent naming and code organization
✓ Follows existing project patterns (templates, static files structure)

**Minor Notes:**
- Relies on DeviceViewSet having failures prefetched (already in place)
- E2E tests use fresh_dev_eui fixture for data isolation
- CSS uses custom properties for theme support
- JS handles both search page and detail page from single file

**All Acceptance Criteria Met:**
1. ✓ Device list displays with search and filters
2. ✓ Search by dev_eui, filter by status and failure type
3. ✓ Sorting works on columns
4. ✓ Pagination with prev/next
5. ✓ Device detail displays all required information
6. ✓ Active failures shown with details
7. ✓ Health config displayed
8. ✓ Responsive on mobile/tablet/desktop
9. ✓ Light/dark mode rendering
10. ✓ E2E tests pass on multiple viewports

Status: PASS — Implementation complete and ready for production.
